content: {"praised":["Humor is entertaining and subtle, with clever under‑the‑breath jokes.","Robert Downey Jr. and Zach Galifianakis have great chemistry.","Adult language makes the comedy feel fresh and appropriate.","The film feels like a modern take on Planes, Trains & Automobiles.","The pacing keeps the audience engaged throughout."],"criticized":["Story feels recycled from Planes, Trains & Automobiles.","Lacks warmth, depth, and charm of the original.","Writing is poor and unoriginal.","Characters are one‑dimensional and poorly developed.","Tone is too harsh and lacks emotional resonance."]}
